lines.351: the holy Collection of the Devotees in eleven verses
lines.352: the lord of Tirunavalur composed, famed in every direction.
lines.353: The good Collection of the Devotees he composed begins with Tillai, then Ilaimalinda,
lines.354: then the shining Mummai, Tirunindra, Vambarava, Varkonda,
lines.355: the well-joined Poyyadimai, Karaikkandan, and after Kadalsulnda,
lines.356: the Pattar of jeweled words, with Maraina of lasting glory.
lines.357: Restraining the five racing senses, so that my deeds of old
lines.358: might wither, what penance did I do, standing firm, that I might tell
lines.359: of those in the Collection of the Devotees whose glorious holy feet the gods of heaven wear on their heads,
lines.360: the rich great fame of these holy ones, in an antati?
